changes.before: Replaced. Local Law #1 of 2024 (a 12-month moratorium, adopted 2024-05-14) expired on its own terms around 2025-05-14, well before the reference date. The Town Board subsequently held a June 9, 2026 public hearing and adopted Local Law #1 of 2026, a permanent law amending and replacing the 2022 Solar Law to regulate both solar energy systems and battery energy storage systems. The Town's current official laws page (townofleydenny.gov/government/laws) lists this permanent law and no longer lists any moratorium law. A tracker (Carina Energy) still lists Leyden as an active UTILITY_SCALE moratorium as of September 2026, but this appears to be stale relative to the Town's own site.
